intent: Admit one additive, fail-closed SADHANA deployment-candidate surface. The surface may validate and stage an exact unmerged Git-bundle release for a sole Megh writer and a fenced AGNI standby, render only loopback API/dashboard services plus private Tailscale Serve, schedule an exact campaign stop and independently verifiable snapshots, and must reject public exposure, automatic failover, unpinned source or evidence, escaping virtual-environment links, cash spend, or canonical/merged claims.

commit.message: governance: admit SADHANA VPS release envelope

interface_mismatches: The canonical production release runner admits merged origin/main descendants, while this time-bounded campaign explicitly needs an unmerged deployment candidate; the new contract must label that weaker authority and pin exact ancestry rather than misusing canonical-release semantics.

The existing full dashboard API lifespan initializes writable runtime subsystems; this release requires a dedicated loopback observer that admits only the immutable mission projection and keeps any API scratch state separate from canonical writer state.
A fresh process, successful Git checkout, model roster, or replicated SQLite file is not evidence that useful work happened or that an independent verifier accepted it.
High availability is requested but automatic promotion would create split-brain writer authority; AGNI must remain explicitly disabled and fenced until a manual, evidence-backed failover decision.
honest_blockers: This admission changes no runtime code, builds no release, installs no service, changes no Tailscale route, contacts no VPS, and proves no campaign liveness.
The final release SHA and closeout receipt hash cannot be truthfully sealed until all campaign integration commits are fixed; deployment must consume a later external mode-0600 exact manifest.
Private Tailscale reachability still depends on the operator's tailnet ACL and iPhone identity, neither of which a repository fixture can prove.
Subscription provider capacity and cash budget are separate runtime controls; this release surface may require cash_budget_usd=0 but cannot prove upstream quota availability.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the admission commit. No host, service, route, release directory, database, authority lease, provider account, or external state is changed by this packet.
